entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  MACD divergence (1d) = hidden bullish -> +35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  distance to EMA20 = +3.72% -> -22 (weight 1.8) - Price 2,471.65 vs EMA20 2,383.05
  RSI 1h = 38.6 -> +20 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone
  resistance proximity = 23.6% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  volume = 0.54x average -> -20 (weight 1.0) - Thin participation - moves made on low volume are less reliable
  Bollinger position = 59% of band -> -15 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  RSI daily = 61.6 -> -8 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (9.5) = +2.3 -> WAIT
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
